result.topic_en: Numerical computation of the roots of the quartic $5x^4-16x^3+6x^2+40x+13=0$: after deflation to a cubic and a substitution, a real root is found via a Cardano-type logarithmic computation, and a complex root pair is noted.

methods.what: Deflation of the quartic by the root x = -1 (division by x+1) to a cubic
Substitution y = 3x to make the cubic's coefficients convenient, then normalization to a monic cubic
Shift y = 4.2 - z removing the quadratic term (depressed cubic), with the coefficients computed in a synthetic-division scheme
Logarithmic (Cardano-type) computation of the real root of the depressed cubic
Back-substitution to obtain a real root of the original equation
Complex root pair of the quartic, together with a list of the roots of other equations
